description: Unit test class for {@link DittoProtocolAdapter} checking conversion between Adaptable objects and protocol-specific command, response, and event objects in the Ditto protocol, using JUnit and AssertJ.

classes.name: DittoProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the conversion logic between Adaptable and protocol-specific message objects in Ditto protocol.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the underTest instance before each test.

methods.name: topicPathFromString
methods.description: Tests parsing of a string into a TopicPath object.

methods.name: thingErrorResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an Adaptable representing a Thing error response into a ThingErrorResponse object.

methods.name: policyErrorResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an Adaptable representing a policy error response into a PolicyErrorResponse object.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to a ThingModifyCommand object.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandFromAdaptableWithPolicyToCopy
methods.description: Tests conversion of an Adaptable to a ModifyThing command with a copy policy.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion from Adaptable to ModifyThingResponse objects, for created and modified responses.

methods.name: thingQueryCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to RetrieveThing command, including with selected fields.

methods.name: thingLiveQueryCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to live RetrieveThing command, with channel set to "live".

methods.name: thingQueryCommandResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to RetrieveThingResponse.

methods.name: thingSearchCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to ThingSearchCommand, with and without selected fields.

methods.name: subscriptionEventFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion from Adaptable to SubscriptionCreated event.

methods.name: thingEventFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to ThingModified event.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from Adaptable to a ModifyFeatureProperty command.

methods.name: thingMessageFromAdaptable
methods.description: Checks the extraction of subject and ID from topic path.

methods.name: acknowledgementToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion from an Acknowledgement signal to Adaptable.

methods.name: acknowledgementFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests parsing an Adaptable into an Acknowledgement signal.

methods.name: acknowledgementsToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of multiple acknowledgements to Adaptable.

methods.name: acknowledgementsFromJson
methods.description: Tests parsing acknowledgements from a JSON Adaptable.
